title: SUSMI Welcome Mixer
description: Kick off Semester 2 with new members, execs, and mentors. Light snacks, society overview, and project interest boards.

title: MedTech Foundations: From Bench to Bedside
description: Guest clinicians and engineers unpack how early-stage medical devices move from lab prototypes into clinical pathways.

title: Workshop: Python for Bioinformatics
description: Hands-on intro to pandas and Biopython for sequence analysis. Bring a laptop; no prior bioinformatics required.

title: AI in Radiology: Promise and Pitfalls
location: Susan Wakil Health Building, Lecture Theatre A
description: Radiologists and ML researchers discuss model validation, clinical deployment, and what students should learn next.

title: Wearables Lab Night
description: Prototype a simple heart-rate sensing workflow with off-the-shelf sensors and discuss signal quality vs clinical standards.

title: MedHack S2: 24-Hour Health Challenge
description: Cross-disciplinary teams tackle a healthcare brief overnight. Mentors from industry and research on site.

title: Industry Night: Health Startups & Hospital Innovation
description: Panel with founders and hospital innovation leads on internships, pathways, and building in regulated spaces.

title: End-of-Semester Social
description: Celebrate the semester, showcase project demos, and thank volunteers before exams.
